decisions.rationale: Commodity PM2.5 module measured within the Bar on the bench; ESPHome already reads it. Nothing to build.
decisions.keep_cost_note: 18 USD per unit; replace every 2-3 years

decisions.rationale: NDIR module measured within the Bar; ESPHome already reads it.
Local notifications measured under 5 s; thresholds set in the app; no cloud path, so the security threshold is met. The consumer product fails the Bar on privacy and cost.
Recorder retention is configurable to 30+ days; history view exists on the phone.

decisions.delta: Configure reboot-on-Wi-Fi-loss and hardware watchdog; add a weekly forced-calibration routine for CO2; add a 'readings stopped' alert in Home Assistant; mains power; vented enclosure with a tool-free sensor door. Nothing else.
decisions.rationale: ESPHome gets most of the way; the Graveyard says reconnects, drift and dust are what kill these. The delta is configuration plus a small physical build, not a new system.

No candidate produces a monthly plain-language summary with calibration status. It is a small scheduled script against Home Assistant's history API; the Prospector's ROM is under two days of work. Priority is 'could', so it is sequenced last and may be cut without touching the others.
decisions.why_not_keep: cand-ha best fit 0.4: sends scheduled messages but has no trend narrative or calibration status; cand-consumer (0.5) fails security and cost thresholds.
decisions.why_not_bend: Bending Home Assistant automations yields a message, not an assembled report with trends and calibration state; the logic is new regardless, so it is a BUILD against a kept API rather than a modification of a kept part.

overall_rationale: Reuse ratio 0.83: four KEEP, one BEND, one small BUILD on a 'could' capability. Build scope is an enclosure, configuration, a calibration routine and one script. The want is met mostly by things that already exist.

tripwires.condition: A candidate appears that produces monthly narrative reports locally - turn C6 into KEEP

signoffs.note: agree; cut C6 first if the build runs over
